newsitem.title: ITALY: Brazil BNDES to launch 300 bln lire bond Wenesday.
newsitem.headline: Brazil BNDES to launch 300 bln lire bond Wenesday.

text.p: Brazil's National Development Bank (BNDES) will launch a 300 billion lire, five-year fixed-rate bond on Wednesday, the first emerging market deal in lira this year and the first by a Brazilian sovereign issuer.
The announcement was made at a roadshow presentation in Milan by lead managers Credito Italiano, Merrill Lynch and Paribas.

The bond has the same rating as the Republic of Brazil: B+ by S&P, B1 by Moody's and BB by the Japanese rating agency JBRI. It will be listed in Luxembourg and settlement will probably be five weeks after the launch.
The loan will be used to finance medium- and long-term development projects.
